bio: Fans of Thai cuisine are in good hands at this restaurant with an attractive decor, where diners can enjoy flavoursome dishes made from high-quality produce – authentic Thai flavours are guaranteed here. The dishes are accompanied by a varied selection of wines including some rarities. And the cocktail menu is also worth a look. There is also a delightful bar at the back of the restaurant. In summer, the seats in the inner courtyard are especially inviting....
